observation: The first two isolated Postgres startup attempts stopped before migrations because the hardened tmpfs PGDATA parent was root-owned mode 0700. The pinned Alpine image executes PostgreSQL as uid 70 gid 70 and could not create the pgdata child directory.
affected_invariant: Rehearsal state must remain tmpfs-backed and writable only by the pinned service identity; startup failures must retain diagnostic evidence before teardown.
failing_evidence: mkdir: can't create directory '/var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata': Permission denied
correction: Bound all rehearsal tmpfs mounts to the locally verified pinned-image identity uid 70 gid 70 without relaxing loopback, internal-network, no-pull, noexec, nosuid, or nodev controls. The runner now captures service logs before teardown on startup failure.
regression_assertion: Preflight requires the exact uid=70,gid=70 PGDATA tmpfs contract and runtime inspection must still prove tmpfs state.
